info.name: Docusign Retrieves a list of user signature definitions for a specified user.

params.name: accountId
params.description: The external account number (int) or account id GUID.

params.name: userId
params.description: The user ID of the user being accessed. Generally this is the user ID of the authenticated user, but if the authenticated user is an Admin on the account, this may be another user the Admin user is accessing. **Note**: For the [GET /v2/accounts/{accountId}/envelopes](https://developers.docusign.com/esign-rest-api/reference/Envelopes/Envelopes/listStatusChanges/#envelopesInformation) method, the `user_id` query parameter is not implemented and should not be used.

items.docs:
Retrieves the signature definitions for the specified user.

The userId parameter specified in the endpoint must match the authenticated user's user ID and the user must be a member of the account.

The `signatureId` parameter accepts a signature ID or a signature name.
